answer: Forged keys cannot pre-press a marble face into a dune crest surveyed only underfoot. A claimant locks 13.80 POA and draws one 17-byte veined disk from the epoch seed XOR a 28-bit berm lot posted 17 minutes earlier. They run a 9-minute ridge voyage; at three stakes 105 seconds apart they press a 12-byte wind-shadow imprint that two non-kin pilots hash with the disk. Peers recompute the hashes against the posted crest map and refuse a second disk on that berm. Cost: 13.80 POA plus one live walk. A pre-cut imprint, late stake, or reused disk burns 72% and buries the berm for eight epochs.
